title: Chapter 63: One Super And Five Strong
content:
Chapter 63: One Super And Five Strong

Wu Qing and everyone reached a basic consensus, and the next thing will be easier to handle.

Everyone knew in their hearts that if Wu Qing did not come out to ease the relationship between the alliance and the Tengu clan, the future of the alliance would be very bad.

The Tengu clan has done a very good job in the intelligence work of each independent territory. The 50,000 elite troops they proposed happened to be stuck in the difficult points of each territory.

If we really want to send out all our troops, if we all work together, we can still gather 50,000 elite troops, but this will require all the accumulation of each territory.

How many troops to send to each territory and who will command these troops are all big questions.

No matter how these problems are dealt with, the alliance will fall into a situation of contradictions, disunity, and disunity. Even if it is lucky enough to survive the immediate disaster, it will be difficult to pose a threat to the Tengu clan in the future.

This is an honest strategy to attack the mind, and for ordinary people, there is no solution at all.

Because all living things have a selfish and self-interested nature, and this nature is still prevalent in intelligent creatures.

Meng, Hu Wei and other lords saw the sinister intentions of the Tengu clan, so they would rather fight to the death with the army of the evil god camp than fall into this trap.

Only Wu Qing can solve this problem!

For other lords, sending troops is a major failure, a matter of life and death.

The danger of this kind of battlefield can be imagined. The little luck gained on the battlefield cannot make up for the huge loss of troops in the territory.

After this battle, all territories will be finished.

For Wu Qing, sending the Zerg to participate in the war is a profit.

Not to mention how much impact the massive system resources brought by the war will have on the development of the Zerg, the prestige and voice of the alliance brought about by this is a huge gain.

This is a good thing that can achieve multiple things with one stone, and Wu Qing will certainly not let it go.

With Wu Qing, the seemingly selfless leader, not only did the Tengu clan's calculations not have the desired effect, but it actually strengthened the unity of the alliance.

With Wu Qing at the forefront and the remaining five thousand troops being allocated, not to mention everyone will rush to contribute, at least no one will be upset because of this issue.

Wu Qing didn't feel unfair. No one in the alliance had the right to cry out. This would invisibly solve many problems.

"A thousand tiger cavalry and a thousand feather tribe archers from my tiger leader go to battle!"

Meng was the first to speak out and seize the two thousand troop quota.

"Meng, the Yu Clan archers cannot represent the Tiger Leader in the battle, they have to fight on behalf of our Wutong Village!"

With a smile on his face, Yu Chong took back a thousand troops of the Tiger Leader without hesitation. The Yu Clan archer was a mercenary from Wutong Village and was indeed not suitable to represent the Tiger Leader in the war.

"We, the Qianyu Clan's mounted archers from Wutong Village, are out to fight!"

The Tiger Leader sent out the most powerful Tiger Cavalry, and Wutong Village, not to be outdone, sent out the strongest Feather Tribe Cavalry Archer.

"I, the White Wolf One Thousand Wolf Cavalry, are out to fight!"

Bai Yan spoke up first this time.

"Then I, Hu Jiaqiu, will send out a thousand fox cavalry."

"I, Blackstone Castle, have sent out a thousand Stone Clan heavy infantry."

Hu Wei and Shi Gan spoke out one after another, and the five thousand troop quota was divided among the five major territories.

The other lords looked at each other, as if it had nothing to do with them.

You can see from the number of troops sent that the alliance has not yet been formally established, and a pattern of one super five has already been formed.

"Okay! Then this is how the five thousand troops will be distributed!"

"If other territories want to contribute, they can contribute to the city under construction in Daxia Territory, and it will be counted in the alliance contribution!"

With a strong hammer, the matter was settled.

"Let's discuss the number of troops sent each time and see how to send them out, which is most beneficial to us."

Meng said, looking at Wu Qing.

The main force in sending troops this time is Wu Qing, and Wu Qing also has the main decision-making power.

"Let's set the number of troops for the first time at 20,000. Our Zerg tribe will send 15,000 troops, and you will send 5,000 troops."

"I will personally lead the army to fight. Don't worry, I will do my best to ensure that your five thousand elite soldiers return safely!"

Wu Qing solemnly promised.

"You want to go to the battlefield in person! Then I will definitely be indispensable! I will personally lead the Tiger Cavalry to accompany you to the battlefield!"

Without even thinking about it, he decided to accompany Wu Qing on the battlefield, which made Wu Qing a little touched. After all, his current body was an insect clone.

In this situation, there are some things that cannot be explained. However, through these two days of getting along, Wu Qing has learned a little bit about Meng's character. Meng will not do anything he is not sure about. Since he dares to go, he must have confidence in his own strength. Be confident.

"I'll go too!"

Bai Yan, who seemed very cold, was very proactive in sending troops.

"I'll go too, everyone will take care of each other, and at least we'll be safe!"

Yu Chong smiled.

"With so many of you gone, Shi Gan and I will stay in the territory. If anything happens to the alliance, it will be up to us to deal with it."

Hu Wei decided to stay with Shi Gan. As they fought in the front, they had to guard the rear. It would be bad if their hometown was raided.

The first troop dispatch was decided, with Wu Qing, Meng, Bai Yan and Yu Chong leading fifteen thousand Zerg and tiger cavalry, Yu clan cavalry archers, wolf cavalry, fox clan cavalry and stone clan heavy armor. There are 1,000 infantrymen each, making a total of 20,000 troops.

These are the most elite troops in each territory. With Wu Qing's selfless performance, all the five territories have shown their best performance.

Such a lineup, even with only 20,000 troops, should exceed the expectations of the Tengu clan.

Because there is a definition of elite. You say it is not an elite military unit, but I say it is the most elite military unit in my territory. There is no unified judgment standard for this.

The Tengu clan only talks about elites, not standards, and they definitely want to continue to make things difficult in this regard. With the current lineup, it depends on how they find fault.

The Lord of the Rat Clan had not yet brought back the reply from the Tengu Clan so quickly. Under the auspices of Meng, everyone discussed the details of the formation of the alliance, striving to get the Tengu Clan, and then immediately held an alliance ceremony.

It was almost noon before the rat clan lord ran back sweating profusely.

Wu Qing saw that the Rat Clan Lord looked happy, and it seemed that he had settled the matter, so he was relieved.

Otherwise, if they deploy 50,000 troops at once, the Zerg will not have the strength yet.

The risk of dealing with the Bugbear clan's main attack alone was still too great. Even if the Zerg clan could handle it, the surrounding independent territories would certainly not be preserved. This was not what he wanted to see.

"Good news! Good news! After my hard work one by one, the Tengu clan finally agreed to three conditions!"

the Rat Lord shouted as he entered the square.

"However, the Tengu clan also has a requirement, that is, the number of troops sent out for the first time must not be less than 20,000, and if they are truly elite, ordinary troops must not be used to deal with it."

The Rat Clan Lord expressed this condition of the Tengu Clan with some trepidation.

"This request is very reasonable, of course there is no problem!"

Wu Qing responded with a smile.
